notes.title: No Summer Update
notes.notes:
Sorry but there won't be a Summer Update because of retro.

Retro's release is planned to be in November but the summer update which is now going to be a Fall Update has some things of Retro inside it, so I can't release a update with unfinished content sorry!

notes.title: The Summer Update!
notes.notes:
The update will of course be in summer, only when in summer? Summer starts on [b]June 1st[/b] and ends on [b]August 31st[/b].

I announce that the update will be released on July 15th. After that, the weekly updates begin.

notes.title: Translation!
notes.notes:
Don't worry, the big update will be released this summer. But to pass the time, I'll be doing the translation for the store page and all the other things related to the game on Steam, as I recently did with the title for the translation into [b]German[/b], [b]Turkish[/b], [b]Dutch[/b], [b]Czech[/b] and [b]Polish[/b]!

I also have to announce that the [b]Russian[/b], [b]French[/b] and [b]Italian[/b] languages are not supported with subtitles.

notes.title: Weekly Updates!
notes.notes:
Hello,

here's just a little announcement! After the summer update for the testers, there will be weekly updates for the map. In these updates will also be stuff like new items and rarely new mechanics and game chaning features.

Those weekly updates won't be forever! They will only be there for the summer vacation time.

notes.title: The store page release!
notes.notes:
The store page just got released but what does it mean?

It's actually a giant step to the full release of the game and that's why there will be a big content update at the beginning of summer!
